intro.title: Is It Time to Redesign Your Website?
paragraphs: Websites age quickly. Design trends change, most visitors now arrive on phones, Google rewards fast pages, and your business has probably grown since the site was built. An outdated website does not just look old; it quietly loses enquiries, ranks lower and makes your business seem smaller than it is.

A professional website redesign fixes the root problems, not just the colours. We start with an audit of your current site, analytics and search rankings, find what is stopping visitors from becoming customers, and then redesign the structure, content, design and code to solve it. Pages that already rank well are protected with careful SEO migration and redirects.

Whether you need a quick website revamp for a small business, a complete B2B web redesign or an ecommerce store refresh, you get one team for strategy, design, development, content and SEO. See our <wd>web design services</wd>, browse <work>websites we have built</work> or <contact>request a free website audit</contact>.

faqs.title: Website Redesign FAQs
faqs.subtitle: Quick answers about redesigning your website.

items.q: How much does a website redesign cost?
items.a: A small business website redesign typically costs $600 to $2,000, a business or B2B redesign $2,000 to $7,000, and ecommerce or large sites from $7,000. The price depends on pages, content, design and features.

items.q: How long does a website redesign take?
items.a: A small business redesign usually takes 2 to 3 weeks, a full business redesign 3 to 6 weeks, and large or ecommerce redesigns 6 weeks or more.

items.q: Will I lose my Google rankings after a redesign?
items.a: Not if it is done properly. We map every old URL to its new page, set up 301 redirects, keep or improve titles, content and schema, and monitor rankings after launch.

items.q: How do I know if my website needs a redesign?
items.a: Common signs are an outdated look, poor mobile experience, slow loading, falling traffic, few enquiries, difficulty updating content, or a site that no longer matches your business. A free audit will confirm it.

items.q: Can you redesign my website and keep my domain and content?
items.a: Yes. Your domain stays the same and we can keep, improve or rewrite your existing content. We can also keep your current hosting or move you to faster hosting.

items.q: What is an AI website redesign?
items.a: It is a redesign that uses AI where it adds value, such as an AI chat assistant that answers visitors and captures leads, smarter site search, personalised content and faster content updates, while design decisions stay human-led.
